findings.title: Explicitly select the intended offer recipient in the browser journey
findings.trigger: Latest Engine supplies received Elin and Oren introductions to the founder. The existing synthetic transfer fixture preserves them.
findings.actual: The browser helper accepts the first participant, Elin, while filling to=oren-home. Core correctly rejects the mismatched recipient; confirm waits 30 seconds for a revision that never commits.
findings.reproduction: Run the committed communication browser qualifier with exact latest Engine/Catalog root overrides. The first Rise offer times out.
findings.diagnosis: A diagnostic copy explicitly selecting oren passes all six commands, conserved transfers, original-result recovery, privacy and mobile checks. Product source and committed tests were not patched.
findings.required_change: Select the received recipient explicitly before preparing the offer; assert intended recipient and report rejected responses instead of silently timing out. Preserve the new legitimate introductions and existing Core recipient checks.

findings.title: Remove the 3.4.3-only expectation from running-build checks
